title: Make the garden gate read as a gate
where: east lane, x6 z0..2, y1..2 (left end of the street view)
instruction: In build.mjs replace the single open oak_fence_gate at (6,1,0) with a framed entrance: oak_log posts (axis y) at (6,1,0) and (6,2,0), the open oak_fence_gate at (6,1,1) facing east (open=true), a cobblestone_wall cap on (6,3,0), and a lantern (standing) on the cap. Keep (6,0,*) path blocks.

title: Add a roof eave lip on the front and back
where: north and south roof edge, y4-y5, z0 and z8
instruction: In build.mjs add a row of upside-down deepslate_tile_stairs (B.stairs('deepslate_tile','south','top') for the north edge at z0, facing north at z8) at y5 across x0..5 so the roof overhangs the wall by one block. Keep the grid at 7x7x9; re-run mcd paint with rules.txt afterwards.

title: Chimney on the west gable
instruction: Run `mcd roof` with --chimney 1,5 or add a 1x1 stone_bricks chimney from y5 to y6 at (1,5), capped with a stone_brick_slab, keeping total height 7. Weather it with `mcd paint` (weather 0.4).

title: Hang a second small sign by the barrel
where: north face, x0 z1 y3 (above the barrel, right of the READING ROOM board)
instruction: B.sign('spruce', ['PUBLIC','RECORD'], {facing:'north', color:'black'}) placed on the wall at (0,3,0).

title: Moss and cracks at the base
instruction: mcd paint rule: `all faces rows 0-2 where stone_bricks -> gradient mossy_stone_bricks..stone_bricks up`, then `all faces ground row -> weather 0.5`. Compare before/after and keep only if it does not read as stripes.

title: Window surrounds in deepslate on every side
where: north x3 y2-3; west x0 z3-4; east x5 z3,5; south x2-3
instruction: mcd paint: `all faces openings -> frames deepslate_bricks`, then `north openings -> lintels flat deepslate_bricks`. Check nothing grows past 7 wide.

title: Curtains on the side and back windows
instruction: B.banner('red',[['stripe_center','white']],{facing:'east'}) at (1,3,3) and (1,3,4) for the west; facing 'north' at (2,3,6),(3,3,6) for the back. Keep colours the same as the front curtains.

title: Operator touch: clean quartz doorstep
instruction: Replace the doorstep stone_brick_slab at (1,0,0) in build.mjs with smooth_quartz_slab (type top). Change nothing else: the Reading Room is a humble Concord annex with only a token operator touch.

title: Interior: floor rug and warm light
instruction: Place red_carpet at (2,1,4),(3,1,4) and a candle on the lectern-side stool; replace the chest at (3,1,6) with a bookshelf stack. Re-check `mcd check` walkability stays true at the door (x1,z2).

title: Fix walkability readout and door reveal
where: door cell (1,1..2,2) and interior path z2..6
instruction: mcd check reports 'not walkable end to end' (narrowest 1). Remove the bookshelf at (1,1,3) and (1,2,3) so the entry has a 2-wide path, then re-run mcd check.
